title: fanoutqa: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old? (cc4e6774f97b0101)

chat_history.content: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?

content.content:
We need to list heads of state of founding countries of EU (founding members 1957 Rome Treaty: Belgium, France, West Germany (FRG), Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands). Also known as six founding members. Heads of state: In modern times, current heads of state: Belgium's monarch King Philippe (born 1960), France's President Emmanuel Macron (born 1977), Germany's President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (born 1956) or Chancellor? Head of state is President; Chancellor is head of government. Italy's President Sergio Mattarella (born 1941). Netherlands' King Willem-Alexander (born 1967). Luxembourg's Grand Duke. But question: "Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?" So need to identify all heads of state of those countries who are older than 80. As of now (2025?), we need to check current heads of state ages. Let's assume current date 2025-11-02. Who are heads of state? Belgium: King Philippe, born 1960, age 65. France: President Emmanuel Macron, 1977, age 48. Germany: President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, born 1956, age 68. Italy: President Sergio Mattarella, born 1941, age 84. Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander, born 1967, age 58. Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri, born 1955, age 69. So only Italy's President is >80: Sergio Mattarella, 84. Also maybe Germany's Chancellor? But head of state is President. The question likely expects Italy only. But maybe also older than 80: maybe the Dutch president? No. So answer: Sergio Mattarella of Italy. Also potential exception: if we consider the current heads of state as of 2024? But question: "Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?" So answer: Italy's President Sergio Mattarella. If include former? But probably just current. So answer: Sergio Mattarella. If include other like a former EU founding member head of state older than 80, but question seems current. So answer: Italy's President Sergio Mattarella (born 1941). No other. Also note that the EU founding members include the six. So answer: only Italy. If someone else older than 80? Let's double-check: Belgium's King Philippe is 64. France: Macron is 47. Germany: Steinmeier is 68. Italy: Mattarella 84. Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander 57. Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri 68. So yes only Italy.

Thus answer.

content:
**Only one of the six founding‑state heads of state is over 80 years old:**

| Country | Head of State | Title | Date of Birth | Current Age (as of Nov 2025) |
|---------|---------------|-------|---------------|-------------------------------|
| Italy   | Sergio Mattarella | President of the Italian Republic | 29 July 1941 | 84 years old |

All other heads of state of the EU’s founding members (Belgium, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Luxembourg) are younger than 80.
